body: Wire server/job.RecastTracker into apps2/mud. RecastTracker initialized per-job (WAR/WHM) on login and on setjob. ja <ability-id> fires ability with recast gate; provoke adds 2000 CE, benediction restores HP/MP. recasts shows ready/recast-remaining per ability. Level gate enforced.
title: S97-01: MUD job ability recast system — server/job.RecastTracker, ja/recasts commands
